descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
ALTEN Romania is part of the ALTEN Group, a leader in IT and Engineering Consulting. We develop innovative and sustainable technical solutions that meet the needs of our local and international partners.
 We are currently looking for a Cybersecurity Analyst to join a customer-facing cybersecurity team, supporting the implementation, administration, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of cybersecurity solutions across IT and OT environments .
 A typical day might include the following: 
Providing technical support and cybersecurity consultancy to customers. 
Investigating and resolving cybersecurity, infrastructure and network-related incidents. 
Performing troubleshooting, root cause analysis and incident response activities. 
Designing, implementing, configuring and supporting Windows Server Infrastructure , including Active Directory, Domain Controllers, NPS, WSUS, PKI/Certification Authority and Remote Access Services . 
Managing and securing network environments using technologies such as Fortinet, Cisco, Palo Alto, Hirschmann, Netgear and Phoenix Contact . 
Supporting firewalls, VPNs, routing, switching, network segmentation, secure remote access and network hardening initiatives. 
Implementing and maintaining network monitoring solutions, including WhatsUp Gold . 
Administering endpoint security platforms such as Trellix, CrowdStrike and Symantec , including malware investigations, policy management and endpoint protection optimization. 
Supporting backup and recovery environments using Veeam, Acronis and Veritas , including restore testing and disaster recovery activities. 
Working with OT security and intrusion detection platforms including Claroty, Nozomi Networks and Dragos . 
Implementing and supporting Multifactor Authentication (MFA) solutions, including DigitalPersona . 
Preparing technical documentation and collaborating with customers, vendors and internal teams.
 To ensure success in this role, you need the following experience and skills: 
Minimum 3 years of experience in Cybersecurity, Network Security, IT/OT Infrastructure, System Administration or Technical Support . 
Experience with Windows Server, Active Directory, Domain Controllers, NPS, WSUS, PKI and Remote Access Services . 
Experience with network and security infrastructure , including firewalls, routers, switches, VPNs and secure network architectures . 
Experience with endpoint security, antimalware, EDR and application allowlisting solutions . 
Experience with backup and recovery technologies . 
Experience with IDS (Intrusion Detection Systems) and OT Security Monitoring platforms . 
Experience with MFA and authentication technologies . 
Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills. 
Excellent customer-facing and communication skills. 
Good English language skills.
 Nice to have: 
Experience within Operational Technology (OT) environments. 
Certifications such as Cisco, Fortinet, CompTIA, ISC2, ISACA, SANS/GIAC or ISA .
 Only eligible candidates will be contacted in a maximum of 2 weeks. Any information provided is treated as confidential.
